Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_DM_02033] Reporting up download failed to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service RequestDownload or RequestUpload is received,
which results in a negative response, the DM shall report a security event
SEV_UDS_REQUEST_UP_DOWNLOAD_FAILED to IdsM (see [26] and table
[SWS_DM_02034]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02034].
⌋
[SWS_DM_02034] Security event context data definition: SEV_UDS_REQUEST_
UP_DOWNLOAD_FAILED
